# MULAN 沐岚

> MULAN (沐岚) is a Foshan manufacturer of aging-friendly bathroom products: seated showers, rise-assist toilet frames, grab bars and complete smart bathroom packages for distributors, OEM brands and elderly-care operators.

沐岚（MULAN）是佛山的适老化卫浴制造商，提供坐式淋浴器、电动起身助力架、安全扶手和适老化智能卫浴空间套餐，服务经销商、OEM 品牌和养老机构。

## Products
- Multifunctional seating shower (多功能坐式淋浴器): Seated or standing bath, 8 outlets, back massage, folding armrests.
- Multifunctional split shower (多功能分体式淋浴器): Rotating upper and lower spray arms; with or without top spray.
- Electric rise-assist stand (电动起身助力架): One-touch silent seat lift for the toilet. IPX4, 100–240 VAC.
- Wall-mounted shower chair (挂墙淋浴椅): PU seat pad, anti-slip feet, folds up when not in use.
- Wall-mounted folding stool (挂墙折叠凳): Flips 180°, anti-slip surface, ABS and stainless steel, 250 kg.
- Grab bars and armrests (安全扶手系列): L-shaped, U-shaped flip-up, side flip-up and washbasin armrests.
- Smart bathroom cabinet (智能浴室柜): Wheelchair accessible; mirror tilts 0–15° for users of any height.
- Automatic shower machine (自动洗澡机): For care homes: about 4 minutes and 80–100 L of water per bather.
